caption: The video captures a woman in a white bathrobe with a towel wrapped around her hair, applying makeup while gazing into a mirror. The left foreground shows the blurred back of her head and shoulder and her raised hand gripping the mascara tube, while the right side presents her clear reflection holding the thin wand. A translucent panel floats over the reflection, displaying the time and the words Morning News above an animated waveform and a row of playback icons. Within the reflection the wand tip sweeps steadily downward from the outer corner of her eye across the cheekbone toward the jawline. The blurred foreground hand stays raised near her head, holding the tube, as the reflected wand and its hand travel down. Near the middle she blinks once, eyes briefly closing before reopening as the wand continues its slow descent. The waveform bars shift height and pattern continuously, while the Morning News text and playback icons hold fixed screen positions. The framing drifts slightly, nudging the background tiles and reflected face. The makeup motion stays ongoing through the last frame.
